name: All Included (Classic drinks + Basic Wi-Fi)
notes: Upcharge vs cruise-only is not published and varies by sailing, so the optimizer skips it until a price is known. Staff gratuities not included (beverage gratuities are). Default US fare type.

name: Princess Plus
notes: 15 drinks/day up to $15 each, 1-device Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, 4 casual meals. $75 on Sun and Star Princess; +$5 if bought onboard.

name: Princess Premier
notes: Unlimited drinks up to $20, 4-device Wi-Fi, unlimited specialty dining, crew appreciation, excursion credit, photos. $110 on Sun and Star Princess.

name: Have It All
notes: Signature Beverage Package (15 drinks/day up to $12), Surf Wi-Fi, specialty dinners: 1 (4-9 nights), 2 (10-20), 3 (21+); 1 is modeled. Excursion credit $100/$200/$300. $65/day for departures from summer 2027. Gratuities not stated as included.
